observation: Two rounds on the detection axis moved the proxy monotonically 0.555 -> 0.596 -> 0.622 and correspondence_f1@15 0.201 -> 0.277 -> 0.324 while every evidence feature stayed flat (depth_nan_ratio 0.1177 -> 0.1177 -> 0.1177, ring_count_error 0 throughout, sam_fill_rate 0.729 -> 0.727 -> 0.727, recentre residual 2.5 cm). Round 2 (oblique/horizontal Hough 80, maxLineGap_oblique 20, binary 150, inter_radius 0.08) did NOT over-tighten: F1 rose again, so the fallback plan of stepping thresholds back is not triggered. The gain per round is shrinking (+0.076 then +0.047 F1) and three of the five detection knobs are already at their bounds (maxLineGap_oblique 20, inter_radius 0.08; binary/Hough near their tops), so the remaining headroom on that axis alone is one more increment. The anchor outlier map shows the residual candidate source: the right half (x>1200) carries a dense speckle cloud (bolt-hole rows, brackets, scan noise around x~1600, y~1450) that is not joint structure yet still feeds oblique/horizontal accumulators; the left half is sparse and clean. In the SC overlay the unsupported (red) label boundaries and unexplained (orange) joint lines remain concentrated in the right-half rings 4-9, where prompt centres were off the two-position ~432 px stagger. Depth map shows lining well-covered with only the usual top/bottom rail voids, so there is margin to tighten the radial gate lower bound without creating lining holes.
rule: d9 -> f_spurious_lines still partially firing on the dense right half; the ontology lists stage_2_denoise.f_under_gate as the likely_upstream of f_spurious_lines and r_tighten_hough explicitly says 'check upstream f_under_gate'. Round 3 therefore pairs the final r_tighten_hough increment with r_radial_gate_tighten on the lower bound only: the T1 prior radius band is r in [2.7, 2.8] m (diameter 5.5), so any point at r < 2.5 protrudes >= 25 cm inward and cannot be lining; lifting mask_r_low to its bound 2.5 (toward the 2.7 prior, i.e. moving the knob toward the tunnel prior per experiences section 4, not away from it) drops brackets/cables/equipment speckle before it can reach the outlier map. mask_r_high is left alone because joint gaps are deeper (larger r) and removing them would starve the joint map (f_joint_oversmoothed -> f_missing_lines). Preconditions per experiences section 7 hold: orientation corr -0.999, residual 2.5 cm << 10 cm gate, NaN 11.8% below family norm, ring count exact. Unfolding locked (stage1_unlocked=false); vertical threshold untouched because synthetic ring-centre verticals already give line count == ring count; SAM geometry untouched because per-class signal is not yet graded (stage 4 still the bottleneck). Watch-out: if depth_nan_ratio rises noticeably above 0.118 or fill rate drops, the gate over-cut lining and mask_r_low must return to its prior value.
failure_mode: stage_2_denoise.f_under_gate (protruding non-lining points in the dense right half surviving the radial gate) -> stage_4_detection.f_spurious_lines (off-pattern oblique/horizontal candidates on rings 4, 7, 8, 9) -> stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset -> unsupported label boundaries and correspondence_f1@15 still only 0.32.
rationale: Round 3 keeps the whole round-2 detection configuration (the best measured so far) and makes two coordinated moves. (1) Final increment on the confirmed axis: hough_threshold_oblique 80 -> 90 and hough_threshold_horizontal 80 -> 90 (upper bounds), binary_threshold 150 -> 155. A genuine joint spans a full ring width (~240 px at 0.005 m/px) and, after dilation, comfortably exceeds 90 collinear votes, whereas speckle chains and bolt-hole rows do not; joint pixels are deep (bright in the outlier map) so 155 still keeps them while trimming more shallow speckle. Binary is stopped at 155 rather than 160 to leave margin against clipping mid-grey joint pixels. maxLineGap_oblique 20 and inter_radius 0.08 are already at their bounds and are retained so left-half joints keep enough interpolated support and no ring falls to horizontal-only detection. (2) Upstream source removal: denoising.mask_r_low -> 2.5 removes points more than 25 cm inside the lining surface (r_lining ~2.75 m) before stage 3, so the speckle that has been feeding the accumulator is not merely out-voted but absent. Both moves push the same failure chain from opposite ends, so the expected effect is the same sign as rounds 1-2: rings 4/7/8/9 either yield ring-local joints on the ~432 px stagger or fall to pattern-assumed centres that already match it, label boundaries align with joint lines, and correspondence_f1@15 rises toward 0.4 while depth_nan_ratio, ring_count_error and sam_fill_rate hold. Attribution rule for reading the result: F1 up with NaN flat = both moves valid; F1 down with det_real_detection_ratio collapsing = Hough over-tightened (revert to 80/80/150); NaN up or fill rate down = radial gate over-cut (revert mask_r_low).
